body:
FINAL SYSTEMS-CRITIC VERDICT: architecture is implementation-ready only after the lead replaces topology-centric design with capability/device trust and freezes field authorities, independent role revisions, immutable public artifacts, CAS display/controller epochs, and explicit partition semantics. The secure baseline is separate-site public Stage on a clean profile plus an already-authenticated private controller; Stage uses its own fullscreen click. Prepared decks/pre-approved cards must form the first vertical slice. Live STT/RAG/public evidence and Chromium placement are earned by later empirical gates, not foundations.
Do not accept these report claims unchanged: (1) private launcher one-click + separate-site Stage; (2) AudienceDisplaySession-only PC + existing Console approval without a preparation precondition; (3) one global revision for role-filtered streams; (4) server-authoritative playback + unconditional local continuation + snapshot overwrite; (5) 'canonical deck' crossing public/private unchanged; (6) zero-byte diode while public service shares private credentials/topics; (7) processing-time current slide for delayed STT finals; (8) offline cache plus revocation without classification.
Open planning fork, not architecture ambiguity: with 5 core FTE a guarded pilot is estimated 13-16 weeks; with 3 generalists, plan 20-26 weeks or remove live-public AI and auto-placement. A BroadcastChannel extended-only demo is allowed solely as a labeled disposable feasibility prototype and provides no proof of production security/two-mode operation.
All peer critiques were incorporated: delivery rejected clever launcher and prioritized protocol harness; scope conceded canary/import checks are hygiene only; logic forced field-specific authority/per-stream revisions/CAS; product supplied falsifiable kill thresholds and live topology-switch/Stage-compromise tests.
